bidders.name: MAHADEV BAKALE( SHRI BHAVANI OFFSET PRINTERS )

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: The agency shall quote the rates in financial bid, the sum total amount of all together proforma uploaded in to the tender. The sub total of proforma for printing of books (1/8 demy size), proforma for printing of books (1/4 demy size), proforma for printing of books (1/4 crown size) and proforma for printing of folders all together sum total shall be mentioned in financial bid.
The quantity shown against each item is approximate and liable to vary.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Suppliers submitting e-Tenders and depositing the Earnest Money shall be deemed to have undertaken to keep the tender open for acceptance for the full period of 90 days from the date of acceptance of rates and will not have any right to withdraw the same before the expiry of the said period.

Please note that the Price quoted in Indian Rupees only. Bids with other currencies will be rejected without further notice/communication to the vendors. Rates quoted are inclusive of all taxes, transportation etc.
The agencies may please note that, the university is at its discretion to withdraw any or all the items invited under the subject notification at any time before issuing the supply order.

Successful tenderer should deposit a sum equal to 5% of the total value of the quoted price as Security Deposit in addition to Earnest Money Deposit as applicable. The same will be returned after commencement of performance period. The SD and EMD amount will not earn any interest.
The successful Tenderer shall execute an agreement on a stamp paper of Rs. 200/- as per Letter of Acceptance (LOA) agreeing to the conditions of Printing and Supplying within the stipulated period
If the Tenderer does not comply the said condition within the stipulated period, the tender will be rejected and EMD and Security deposits will be forfeited.
All disputes arising out of or in any way connected with the Agreement shall be deemed to have arisen in the court of Bagalkot jurisdiction.
The University reserves the right to accept, reject or postpone any or all of the Tenders without assigning any reasons thereof.
Non-compliance by the Tenderer to any conditions will entail rejection of the tender and forfeiture of the EMD.
In case of any dispute arising out of this contract, the decision of the University is final.
Payment will be made after satisfactory service required proper functioning of the Material, Printing etc.
The vendors shall go through the tender notification uploaded in the e-portal for ascertaining the information as to FOR destination and numbers of units etc.,

The agency should mention the correct address for placing the Supply Order in the Bid Document. It may please be noted that no change in address will be allowed at the time of placing the supply order.
If the service found satisfactory, the service will be continued as per university requirement even after end of this financial year with the same quoted rates.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
All bidders shall get updated with corrigendum / addendum issued from time to time during the entire tender process.
